description:
### 1. Overall Layout
The diagram is a publication-quality, flat-design academic data flow chart organized in a top-to-bottom directional flow across four vertical tiers. The design employs a clean, white background with no drop shadows, gradients, or 3D effects, adhering to a modern, minimalist scientific aesthetic.
*   **Tier 1 (Top):** Input data ingestion.
*   **Tier 2 (Upper Middle):** Dual-model independent classification, featuring two parallel processing paths.
*   **Tier 3 (Lower Middle):** Agreement comparison and routing logic.
*   **Tier 4 (Bottom):** A three-way resolution split (Consensus, Auto Dual-Modal, and Arbitrator paths) that ultimately converges into a single reconciliation output at the bottom center. 
An overarching structural annotation spans the left margin alongside Tiers 2 through 4.

### 2. Components and Styling
All text utilizes a clean, academic serif font (such as Georgia). Shapes feature softened geometry with rounded corners.

*   **Input Data Module (Tier 1):** A wide, short rounded rectangle located at the top center. It has a soft muted grey fill with a slightly darker slate grey border. 
    *   *Text:* Line 1 reads "47 Survey Instruments · 6,987 Deduplicated Questions" in a bold, dark serif font. Line 2 reads "PublicSurveyQuestionsMap.csv + Census taxonomy (5 topics, 152 subtopics)" in a smaller, italicized, muted dark grey serif font.
*   **Dual-Model Classification Modules (Tier 2):** Two identical, parallel rounded rectangles placed side-by-side with a clear, empty horizontal gap between them to visually communicate strict vendor independence. Both have a pale ice blue fill and a deep navy blue border.
    *   *Left Box (gpt-5-mini):* Features a solid deep navy blue header bar with "gpt-5-mini" in bold white text. The body contains "6 parallel workers · ~1.5 hrs" (muted italic), "Per question: assign primary topic," and "subtopic, confidence score" (standard dark text), followed by "→ results_openai.jsonl" (muted italic).
    *   *Right Box (claude-haiku-4-5):* Features a solid deep navy blue header bar with "claude-haiku-4-5" in bold white text. The body contains "6 parallel workers · ~30 min" (muted italic), "Per question: assign primary topic," and "subtopic, confidence score" (standard dark text), followed by "→ results_claude.jsonl" (muted italic).
*   **Agreement Analysis Module (Tier 3):** A large, central rounded rectangle positioned below the dual models. It has a white fill and a deep navy blue border.
    *   *Header:* Solid deep navy blue bar with "Agreement Analysis" in bold white text.
    *   *Body Text:* "Routing criterion: topic AND subtopic must both match" (bold dark text), "Topic agreement: 89.2% (κ = 0.84) · Subtopic label: 69.7% (κ = 0.69)" (standard dark text), and "Compound routing agreement: 68.5% (4,765 / 6,954)" (muted italic text).
*   **Auto Dual-Modal Module (Tier 4, Center):** A small rounded rectangle positioned centrally below the Agreement Analysis module. It features a white fill and a thin warm orange border. 
    *   *Text:* "Both models confident", "in different answers →", and "both valid (dual-modal)" (all in a small, dark serif font).
*   **Arbitrator Module (Tier 4, Right):** A medium-sized rounded rectangle positioned to the right of the Auto Dual-Modal box. It has a pale mint green fill and a deep forest green border.
    *   *Header:* Solid deep forest green bar with "claude-sonnet-4-5" in bold white text.
    *   *Body Text:* "Reviews both categorizations", "pick_gpt5mini: 522", "pick_haiku45: 482", "new_concept: 340", and "dual_modal: 19" (all standard dark text).
*   **Reconciliation/Output Module (Tier 4, Bottom):** A wide rounded rectangle at the very bottom center, acting as the final terminus. It has a pale mint green fill and a deep forest green border.
    *   *Header:* Solid deep forest green bar with "master_dataset.csv" in bold white text.
    *   *Body Text:* "6,954 compared · 6,987 total in master" and "38 flagged for human review" (standard dark text).

### 3. Connections and Data Flow
All connectors are strictly straight, orthogonal lines (no curves or diagonals) ending in solid, filled arrowheads.

*   **Tier 1 to Tier 2:** A downward deep navy blue arrow originates from the Input Data module and splits into a Y-fork, directing data into both parallel classification modules.
*   **Tier 2 to Tier 3:** Two independent downward deep navy blue arrows exit the bottom of the classification modules and converge into the top center of the Agreement Analysis module.
*   **Tier 3 to Tier 4 (Three-Way Split):** From the bottom of the Agreement Analysis module, the flow splits into three distinct downward arrows:
    *   *Left Path (Consensus):* A solid downward deep forest green arrow labeled "4,765 agree (68.5%)" (dark text) that bypasses any intermediate boxes and flows directly into the final Reconciliation module.
    *   *Center Path (Auto Dual-Modal):* A downward warm orange arrow labeled "821 auto dual-modal (11.8%)" (warm orange text) pointing into the Auto Dual-Modal module. A subsequent short downward arrow connects this module to the Reconciliation module.
    *   *Right Path (Arbitrator):* A downward warm orange arrow labeled "1,368 to arbitrator (19.7%)" (warm orange text) pointing into the Arbitrator module. A subsequent short downward arrow connects this module to the Reconciliation module.

### 4. Groupings and Annotations
*   **Parallel Independence:** The two model boxes in Tier 2 are grouped by their horizontal alignment and identical styling, but deliberately lack any interconnecting lines or decorative elements between them to emphasize independent operation.
*   **Trust Architecture (Left Margin):** A thin, warm orange vertical bracket spans the left side of the diagram from the top of the Tier 2 classification boxes down to the bottom of the Tier 4 resolution paths.
    *   *Labels:* To the left of the bracket, "Vendor independence" is written in a bold warm orange font. Directly below it, two lines read "Classifiers: OpenAI + Anthropic" and "Arbitrator: different Anthropic model" in a small, muted dark grey font.
